thread:
sam-observability: Postmortem follow-up for 2026-03-22 trace/aggregation gaps. Symptoms: missing spans after aggregator reorder + ETL consumer lag spikes. Pattern observed across 3 incidents in 6 weeks. Need owners, mitigation, and backfill plan.

jess-ops: assigning owners now, we should have owners and a tracker today.

li-eng: I will own the aggregator config and reorder logic investigation. Plan: diff config, run traffic replay, and attempt to reproduce. ETA: Tue EOD (2026-03-24).

tina-sre: I will own ETL consumer resilience and temp mitigation. Proposal: bump consumer_instances 3->6 for peak window and tighten commit window for 12h. Will open PR with commands. ETA: Thu (2026-03-26).

sam-observability: Quick missing-span estimate query returned ~39k spans missing in 24h, concentrated on tenant:acme and tenant:beta.

jess-ops: created OBS-2041 and added owners + tasks. Link in tracker.

li-eng: plan for canary: Canary at 5% traffic with v2-config flag, monitor per-tenant delta for 30m. Need approval for canary deploy.

tina-sre: I approve after CI and smoke checks show drift <0.5% for sample tenants. Adding short-lived alert: etl_consumer_lag > 120s for 5m pages oncall.

li-eng: adding metric aggregator_reorder_count and alert >5/min for 10m. Will add Grafana panel in PR.

sam-observability: Backfill plan: (1) shallow pass on top 10 tenants overnight, (2) full backfill rate-limited next weekend. I'll run shallow and verify.

jess-ops: booking Friday 11:00 handoff to transfer runbooks and confirm mitigation. Daily check-ins for one week.

li-eng: rollback playbook: flip v2 flag, scale aggregator, run quick reconcile. Will include playbook in PR.

tina-sre: if temp mitigation doesn't hold, we'll evaluate durable queueing and persistent offsets; draft tradeoffs in OBS-2041.

sam-observability: Updated OBS-2041 with owners, due dates, and verification checklist. Will post canary results and backfill dry-run status in the issue.

jess-ops: marking owners and due dates. Reconvene Friday after handoff. :white_check_mark:
